name: Velinde Starsong
shortDescription: Night-elf priestess whose journal records her use of the Scythe to summon worgen and her concern when their numbers grow without her intervention.
body: Interpretive portrait. Her journal describes an ancient gnarled branch and weapon; the complete held object is visible in the relevant art. Costume, face and exact item model remain open to Classic comparison. See docs/research/scythe-of-elune-original-mystery-research.md and docs/research/scythe-of-elune-visual-assets.json.
